chapter: Kansas City, Omaha and Lloyd Hunter
title: His mother's singing lessons and church show
summary: His mother took voice lessons from his Dallas music teacher and earlier put together a church show that travelled to small towns.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: But my teacher was altogether different.
He was a rough guy, a lot of them figured. But he taught my mother singing, too, see.
Well, she used to sing all the time, in choirs and things like that. And, well, since it came back to me, when I was a kid, she -- at church, well, she had a show that she put together.
No, this was in Tyler, Texas. I forgot all about that.

And it was for the church.
